# ModelDock

> ModelDock is an open-source control plane for self-hosted multi-user LLM apps built around LiteLLM.
> It docks providers, BYOK credentials, credits, budgets, routing, chat UI, admin controls, MCP, and skills into one deployable service.

ModelDock is useful for developers, homelab users, AI labs, and small teams that want to run a private ChatGPT-like service without rebuilding auth, LiteLLM routing, provider key management, credits, and deployment workflows.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/quickstart.md): Install locally with pnpm and Docker Compose.
- [Architecture](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/architecture.md): Control plane, LiteLLM proxy, database, credential vault, chat UI, and admin app.
- [LiteLLM integration](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/litellm.md): LiteLLM users, virtual keys, budgets, spend tracking, and model access.
- [BYOK provider setup](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/byok.md): User-owned provider credentials.
- [Credits and budgets](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/credits.md): Product credits and LiteLLM budget enforcement.
- [Security model](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/security.md): Credential storage, secret handling, user isolation, audit logs, and safe defaults.
- [Cloudflare deployment](https://modeldock.example.com/docs/deployment/cloudflare.md): Tunnel, Access, WAF, TLS, and admin host separation.

## Comparisons
